snippet.title: Drawmi: Card Shop Announcement Trailer - Draw Your Cards
snippet.description:
Drawmi: Card Shop is coming to Steam Next Fest in October!
Wishlist now at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5086430/Drawmi_Card_Shop
And watch for playtests and the demo!

Drawmi is a new “draw it yourself” game franchise by Doonamai. Whether you, your friends, or your kids enjoy drawing, these games are built to express creativity and bring your drawings to life.

Drawmi: Card Shop is the flagship game of the series. A co-op card shop simulator where you and your friends design every card you sell, then build and run the shop that sells them.

Follow the entire Drawmi Series at: https://drawmigames.com
